title: Prickle Road
style: cinematic dark folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed snare, low brass swells, male baritone, dry close vocal, tape saturation, bittersweet, verse-lift, slow burn
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Walked the prickle road at dusk again
Boots still carrying last year's rain
The thorns don't pick their targets well
They just catch whatever fell

[Verse 2]
I left a piece of shirt on wire
Left a piece of pride at the fire
Left the best part of the argument
Somewhere past the hill's descent

[Chorus]
Prickle road, prickle road
Draws blood before it lets you go
Prickle road, prickle road
You only learn it going slow
